title: Securing AI Agents Against Unauthorized Directives
excerpt: Gen Digital introduces its Agent Trust Hub to protect autonomous AI agents from malicious manipulation and data theft.
body_html:
Autonomous artificial intelligence agents are increasingly gaining access to user systems and legitimate permissions to perform tasks. However, this level of access introduces significant security risks, as these agents can be manipulated into executing harmful commands, deleting files, or stealing sensitive data through malicious plugins, websites, and emails.

To address these emerging vulnerabilities, Gen Digital has introduced the Agent Trust Hub. This system is designed to safeguard AI agents by implementing specific protective measures. These include verifying the skills utilized by the agents, ensuring secure connectivity during operations, and deploying runtime controls that intercept and block dangerous actions before they can be executed.
